name: scdaw_export_project
description: Exports the current project as a native .scdaw.json schema or a DAWproject v1.0 interchange archive (.dawproject) to OPFS conversation storage and/or browser download.

format.description: Export format: 'json' (native .scdaw.json, default) or 'dawproject' (DAWproject v1.0 ZIP)

conversationId.description: Destination conversation ID in OPFS (defaults to 'br:main' / Main)

saveToOpfs.description: Whether to save to OPFS conversation storage (default: true)

saveToWorkspace.description: Whether to trigger browser download of the exported file
